description: Human-reviewed catalogue of the SysEx items the AKM layer sends (ADR-AKM-001, DEC-AKM-003, DEC-AKM-012). The checked-in table juce/akm/include/akm/ItemTable.generated.hpp is generated from this file by juce/tools/generate_akm_items.py, which also compares it with documents/_index/sysex_spec.items.tsv. Edit here, regenerate, review the diff of both.

sections.name: System
sections.note: The two version items of RQ-AKM-044 (FTR-AKM-001) the sampler name (RQ-AKM-052: &02, &03, TASK-AKM-048), and Play Mode and the front-panel lock (RQ-AKM-055: &10, &11, &20, &21, TASK-AKM-051, the Play Mode range 0-3 as the item text defines it, the spec's data column saying "0, 1, 2": a known erratum, see KNOWN_RANGE_ERRATA in generate_akm_items.py, resolved on the real S5000 by TASK-AKM-053 — Play Mode 3 (Muted) set and read back without error), the guarded Clear Sampler Memory (RQ-AKM-056: &32, TASK-AKM-052; every command row of the section is then catalogued, 16/16, `complete` set by TASK-AKM-054 after `--coverage` reported 16/16 with no unaccounted item), the clock and date (RQ-AKM-054: &05, &06, TASK-AKM-050, the REPLY of &05 carrying section 0B, not 02, on the S5000 OS 2.14 — observed by TASK-AKM-053, recorded by TASK-AKM-055 as `replySection`, the year one `Word` holding the whole year, 1980-2079, which fits the spec's own "0-16 (MSB year)" column — 2079 is MSB 16 — where an offset from 1980 would not), the model and available memory (RQ-AKM-053: &04, &30, &31, &33, &34, TASK-AKM-049, the two byte counts as one `Dword` each: the spec writes their REPLY rows with two columns, "MSB" and "LSB", but calls them compound double words, four data bytes; the coverage check does not compare them, the row carrying an ellipsis; to be confirmed on the real sampler by TASK-AKM-053); the rest of the section is FTR-AKM-006's (PLAN-AKM-006). A name is catalogued with the 20-character maximum of the other name fields: the spec states none, and the real sampler's limit is observed by TASK-AKM-053.

sections.name: Program
sections.note: Section 0A is fully catalogued as of TASK-AKM-023: the lifecycle items of RQ-AKM-021 (TASK-AKM-015: &02, &03, &05, &06, &08, &09, plus &10 and &13), the structure/identity items of RQ-AKM-022 (TASK-AKM-016: &0A, &0B, &0C, &0D, plus &11, &14, &15), general program information (TASK-AKM-017: &12, &18, &19), the 76 items of RQ-AKM-024's five parameter groups (TASK-AKM-018 to 022), and the guarded &07 (TASK-AKM-023, RQ-AKM-025).

sections.name: Keygroup
sections.note: Section 08 is fully catalogued as of TASK-AKM-032: keygroup selection (RQ-AKM-028: &01, &02) and the six Set/Get parameter groups of RQ-AKM-030 (General Options, Pitch/Amp, Filter, Filter Envelope, Amplitude Envelope, Aux Envelope; TASK-AKM-027 to 032), 80/80 command rows and 40/40 REPLY formats. `&64`/`&6C` (Aux Envelope) is catalogued as a parameter distinct from `&61`/`&69`, pending real-sampler confirmation (RQ-AKM-032, TASK-AKM-033).

sections.name: Keygroup Zone
sections.note: Section 06 is fully catalogued as of TASK-AKM-036: the 13 non-sample Set/Get parameter items of RQ-AKM-034 (TASK-AKM-035; zone number 0-4 as the first argument of every item, a zone has no `current` selection state of its own, unlike Program/Keygroup) and sample assignment by name (RQ-AKM-035, &01/&21, TASK-AKM-036) — 28/28 command rows. `&27`'s REPLY is catalogued as the Get despite its own command-table label reading "Set Zone Semitone Tune" (RQ-AKM-037 erratum, pending real-sampler confirmation, TASK-AKM-039).

sections.name: Sample
sections.note: Section 0E is fully catalogued as of TASK-AKM-044: the 6 lifecycle items of RQ-AKM-045 (TASK-AKM-040: &05, &06, &08, &09, &0A, &0B, plus &13/&14 pulled in early, mirroring TASK-AKM-015's own precedent for Program's &10/&13); the guarded &07 (RQ-AKM-046, TASK-AKM-041, mirroring Program's TASK-AKM-023); the remaining general information &10-&12 (RQ-AKM-047, TASK-AKM-042, &12 a repeated String REPLY decoded like Program's &19, DEC-AKM-014); the 8 settable parameters and their Gets (RQ-AKM-048, TASK-AKM-043: &20-&24, &28-&2A / &40-&44, &48-&4A), each multi-byte position/loop item split into separate Byte values (positionMsb/Sb2/Sb1/Lsb) rather than the codec's unused `ValueFormat::Dword`, matching every other multi-byte item in this catalogue; and the 4 read-only parameters plus the two grouped-REPLY items (RQ-AKM-049, TASK-AKM-044: &30-&33, &34, &4B) — 34/34 command rows. §0E has its own sampler-wide `current sample` selection state, the same pattern as §0A's current program (documents/_index/sysex_spec.kb.md line 91), not the zone-number-as-first-byte pattern of §06.

sections.name: Disk
sections.note: FTR-AKM-007 (PLAN-AKM-007), 51 rows (35 commands, 16 REPLY formats), the largest single-section lot so far. Disk discovery (RQ-AKM-060, TASK-AKM-057: &01, &04, &05) is catalogued first: &05's REPLY repeats a 6-field-plus-name record once per disk (handle as two Bytes, type, format, SCSI ID, writable, name), decoded like Program's &19 (DEC-AKM-014) rather than through the generic per-value decoder, since no record shape in the catalogue schema mixes fixed fields with a trailing String. Disk selection and status (RQ-AKM-061, TASK-AKM-058: &02, &03, &06-&09) followed, including the &08 naming mismatch between its command title ("index") and its REPLY text ("handle") — confirmed by the spec's own two tables, nothing to settle on hardware. Format, free space and name (RQ-AKM-062, TASK-AKM-059: &0A, &0B, &0E) added the catalogue's first `qword` item (&0B, DEC-AKM-017) and resolved the &0D/&0E decimal-column erratum (`KNOWN_DEC_ERRATA`, documents/_index/sysex_spec.kb.md line 178) the same way §08's &6C was. Folder navigation, listing and management (RQ-AKM-063, TASK-AKM-060: &10-&14, &16, &18) added the catalogue's first item with two `String` arguments (&18 Rename Folder, DEC-AKM-018). Load Folder (RQ-AKM-064, TASK-AKM-061: &15) is one of the items Table 20's own footnote calls potentially long-running, observed to hang the real S5000 for &01 (OBSERVATIONS-RQ-AKM-017-real-sampler-suite.md); guarded for real-sampler use by TASK-AKM-070/TASK-AKM-067, not this task. File listing, info and rename (RQ-AKM-065, TASK-AKM-062: &20-&24, &28) catalogues &23's Compound Double Word as four Bytes, not one `Dword`: its own TSV row decomposes into four comparable columns, unlike §02's Wave memory, whose row is shortened by an ellipsis the coverage check cannot compare at all. Load File with and without dependents (RQ-AKM-066, TASK-AKM-063: &2A, &2B) is the other pair of items Table 20's footnote calls potentially long-running, guarded the same way as &15; &2A's String-then-Byte shape is built by hand (`ProgramSetNumber`'s own precedent), &2B's single String through `makeStringRequest`. Save Memory Item(s) to disk (RQ-AKM-067, TASK-AKM-064: &2C, &2D) fits the generic int64_t path directly (no String), unlike every other write item in this section. Sample audition from disk (RQ-AKM-068, TASK-AKM-065: &30, &31) is named startFileAudition/stopFileAudition in the primitives, not startSampleAudition/stopSampleAudition — those names are §0E's own, a different operation (auditioning a sample already in memory, not a file straight off disk). Destructive command guards (RQ-AKM-069, TASK-AKM-066: &0D, &17, &29) complete all 35 command rows of this section; &0D is split into ejectDisk (always safe, <Data3> = 0) and the guarded ejectDiskDiscardingVirtualSamples (<Data3> = 1), rather than one primitive with an ignorable parameter. Coverage of section §10 and errata resolution (RQ-AKM-072, TASK-AKM-068): `--coverage` reports 35 of 35 command rows covered, `unaccounted: none`; `complete` set to `true` accordingly — the &0D/&0E decimal erratum was already resolved by TASK-AKM-059, nothing left open.

sections.name: Front Panel
sections.note: FTR-AKM-008 (PLAN-AKM-008), 4 command rows and no REPLY format. Key Hold and Key Release (RQ-AKM-073, TASK-AKM-070: &01, &02) are catalogued first: the keycode is a byte of 64-107, the range Table 30 gives, of which only the 43 codes of Table 31 are valid (`&66` is inside the range and listed by no row, note b), so the primitives, not the catalogue, refuse an unlisted code. The data wheel (RQ-AKM-074, TASK-AKM-071: &03, a direction byte 0-1 and 1-8 clicks) and the ASCII keyboard (&04, one byte 0-127) complete the four command rows: `complete` was set by TASK-AKM-074 after `--coverage` reported 4 of 4 spec rows covered with no unaccounted item. The section has no REPLY row and no erratum: Table 31 lists 43 of the 44 keycodes of `&40`-`&6B`, `&66` being listed by no row, which the primitives (not the catalogue) refuse.

sections.name: MIDI Configuration
sections.note: FTR-AKM-009 (PLAN-AKM-009), 7 command rows and no REPLY format. The five switches (RQ-AKM-078, TASK-AKM-077: &01 program change enable 0-1, &02 multi select 0-2, &03 multi select channel 0-31, &04 external APM controller 0-127, &05 aftertouch 0-1) are catalogued first, one byte each; the two MIDI filters (RQ-AKM-079, TASK-AKM-078: &06 allow, &07 ignore) take an event type 0-3 and a channel 0-31, two bytes each, which completes the section's seven command rows: `complete` was set by TASK-AKM-080 after `--coverage` reported 7 of 7 spec rows covered with no unaccounted item. The section has no REPLY row and no erratum; what it sets is stored configuration the sampler cannot read back, so its real-sampler check (RQ-AKM-080) is guided by the owner.

sections.name: MIDI Song Files
sections.note: FTR-AKM-010 (PLAN-AKM-010), 12 command rows and 6 REPLY formats. Song file selection, renaming, deletion and general information (RQ-AKM-082, RQ-AKM-083, TASK-AKM-084: &05, &06, &08, &09, &10, &11, &13, &14) are catalogued first, the same shape as section 0E's lifecycle: a sampler-wide current song file, an index carried as two Byte values (MSB, LSB) and a name as a String. The four set list items (RQ-AKM-084, TASK-AKM-085: &20, &21, &22, &23) have no current selection: each takes its index, and &23 (Rename) carries the index then a String, a shape built by hand like §10's &2A. `complete` was set by TASK-AKM-087 after `--coverage` reported 12 of 12 spec rows covered with no unaccounted item; the section has no erratum beyond the two cosmetic ones of the kb (Table 29's title, Table 28's sub-group header).

sections.name: Multi
sections.note: FTR-AKM-011 (PLAN-AKM-011), 49 command rows and 11 REPLY formats. Multi creation, selection and deletion (RQ-AKM-087, TASK-AKM-089: &01, &02, &05, &06, &08, plus &42 and &43 pulled in early, as TASK-AKM-015 did for Program's &10/&13) are catalogued first: the same shape as section 0A's lifecycle, a sampler-wide current multi, an index carried as two Byte values (MSB, LSB) and a name as a String. The guarded &07 (RQ-AKM-088, TASK-AKM-090), mirroring Program's and Sample's. The twelve part parameters (RQ-AKM-089, TASK-AKM-091: Set &10-&1B, Get &20-&2B) take a part number (0-127) first, like section 06's zone number, then one value in the range of the item. The Gets of general information (RQ-AKM-090, RQ-AKM-091, TASK-AKM-092: &40, &41, &44-&48, &50-&52) complete the section's Gets: &41 and &50 carry a flag then a number like Program's &11/&18, &45/&46/&51 names with a single 00 for none, &47 twelve values (the twelve parameters, in the order of items &20-&2B), &48/&52 one byte per part or per multi. The five Sets of general information (RQ-AKM-092, TASK-AKM-093: &30 rename, &31 program number, &32 and &33 a part's program by index or by name, &34 delete a part's program) complete the section's command rows: &31's shape is conditional (a flag, then a number only when it is 1) and &33's is a part then a String, both built by hand like section 0A's &0A and section 06's &01.
